userId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId(self.session.props.auth.user)
	attrInfo = dict(self.view.custom.tolerances.info)
	
	if attrInfo['attributeToleranceId'] is None:
		self.view.custom.tolerances.info.attributeToleranceId = system.kanoa.quality.config.addTolerance(attrInfo, userId)
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': "Attribute tolerance has been added"})		
	else:
		system.kanoa.quality.config.updateTolerance(attrInfo, userId)
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': "Attribute tolerance has been updated"})
	
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.tolerances.table.data")

	return

system.perspective.print("attributeItemSelected() msg rcvd with %s"%payload)
	
	itemId, itemClassId, itemName, itemClassName = [None] * 4
	
	if len(payload['selection']) > 0:
		value = dict(payload['selection'][0]['value'])
		if value['itemId'] is not None: 
			itemId = value['itemId']
			itemName = value['itemName']
		else: 
			itemClassId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('itemClassId', system.kanoa.item.getItemClasses({'itemClassPath' : value['path']}))
			itemClassName = value['path']
	
	info = dict(self.view.custom.tolerances.info)
	info['itemId'] = itemId
	info['itemName'] = itemName
	info['itemClassId'] = itemClassId
	info['itemClassName'] = itemClassName
	
	self.view.custom.tolerances.info = info
	
	return
